name: Benzphetamine
summary: Benzphetamine, sold under the brand name Didrex among others, is an amphetamine-type stimulant and appetite suppressant used short-term for weight loss along with a doctor-approved, reduced-calorie diet, exercise, and behavioral program. It is prescribed for obesity to people who have been unable to lose weight through exercise and dieting alone. It is a prodrug of dextromethamphetamine and dextroamphetamine.

pharmacology.text: Benzphetamine is a sympathomimetic amine and is classified as an anorectic. The drug's main function is to reduce appetite, which in turn reduces caloric intake. Although the mechanism of action of the sympathomimetic appetite suppressants in the treatment of obesity is not fully known, these medications have pharmacological effects similar to those of amphetamines.

summaryZh: 苄非他明（英語：Benzphetamine），商品名為Didrex，是一種替代苯丙胺，可短期與醫生批准的低熱量飲食、鍛鍊和行為計劃一起使用，以減輕體重。它適用於僅靠運動和節食無法減肥的肥胖症患者。它是右旋苯丙胺和右旋甲基苯丙胺的前體藥物。

sideEffects.en: Reported effects include a fast heartbeat, raised blood pressure, sleeplessness, dry mouth, restlessness and headache. It causes dependence, and it is not suitable in pregnancy because of a risk of birth defects.
sideEffects.zh: 回報的反應包括心跳加快、血壓升高、失眠、口乾、躁動不安與頭痛。它會造成成癮，並因有先天缺陷風險而不適用於懷孕期間。
sideEffects.zhHans: 回报的反应包括心跳加快、血压升高、失眠、口干、躁动不安与头痛。它会造成成瘾，并因有先天缺陷风险而不适用于怀孕期间。

fact.en: It is methamphetamine with a benzyl group on the nitrogen, which the body removes. That means it works by turning into methamphetamine and then amphetamine inside the body.
fact.zh: 苄非他明是在甲基安非他命的氮原子上加一個苄基的產物，而身體會把這個基團移除。因此它的作用方式是在體內先轉化成甲基安非他命，再轉化成安非他命。
fact.zhHans: 苄非他明是在甲基安非他命的氮原子上加一个苄基的产物，而身体会把这个基团移除。因此它的作用方式是在体内先转化成甲基安非他命，再转化成安非他命。
